MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Best of Bread feels like a natural next choice because I want gentle, melodic songs, matching what draws me to Simon & Garfunkel and Jonathan Edwards.",
    "Lesley Gore fits my interest in mid-sixties hits, Fleetwood Mac connects with my classic-rock listening, and another Christmas album suits my recent holiday mood."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Toby Keith's collection misses my current interest in older pop and classic rock; being a greatest-hits album does not make it a musical match.",
    "I cannot judge collections such as The Definitive Collection without knowing the artist, even though I often choose hits collections.",
    "ABBA and the Carpenters appeal to me, but I would choose Bread now because it best fits my mellower listening mood."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to put too much weight on greatest-hits and singles collections without enough attention to whose music they contain.",
    "My interest in familiar older music seems to have been extended too broadly to country hits, which are not what I am seeking now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The gentle, melodic quality connecting some of my past choices matters more today than simply finding another familiar pop collection.",
    "My recent Christmas listening matters alongside my longstanding interest in older pop and classic rock.",
    "Several albums can fit my taste while only one fits the mood I want to pursue right now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understand my interest in nostalgic hits and holiday music, but sometimes treat the collection format as more meaningful than the artist and my current listening mood."
}
